submitted_sql: SELECT t.track_id, SUM(il.unit_price * il.quantity) AS track_revenue FROM public.invoice_line il JOIN public.invoice i ON il.invoice_id = i.invoice_id JOIN public.track t ON il.track_id = t.track_id WHERE i.invoice_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND i.invoice_date < DATE '2025-01-01' GROUP BY t.track_id ORDER BY track_revenue DESC, t.track_id ASC LIMIT 10;
validated_sql: SELECT t.track_id, SUM(il.unit_price * il.quantity) AS track_revenue FROM public.invoice_line AS il JOIN public.invoice AS i ON il.invoice_id = i.invoice_id JOIN public.track AS t ON il.track_id = t.track_id WHERE i.invoice_date >= CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE) AND i.invoice_date < CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY t.track_id ORDER BY track_revenue DESC, t.track_id ASC LIMIT 10
